# ESP32-S3 ChaCha20-Poly1305 stack A/B (#275, #278, #279, #280), CPU at 80 MHz

Interleaved flashes of the fork's stacked ESP32-S3 ChaCha20-Poly1305 branches on one ESP32-S3. The tables below are the control image. [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method, the run counts and what each image is.

- Board: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 class board, ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, 8 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 37:68
- CPU: Espressif ESP32-S3 (Xtensa LX7), 80 MHz
- Toolchain: rustc 1.97.0-nightly (8ea53bcd7 2026-07-08) (esp 1.97.0.0), xtensa-esp32s3-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1
- Control image `ctl`: #275 then: 26-bit Poly1305 and word-XOR ChaCha20 on 32-bit targets
- Control runs: 5 flashes (1, 3, 5, 7, 9 of 8)

## rind against the fastest other library (control image)

Below 1.00× rind is faster. Spread is (slowest − fastest run) over the median, for rind and for the fastest other library. The only other library in this firmware is RustCrypto (ed25519-dalek for Ed25519).

| aead_open/16B | 210.75 µs | RustCrypto + dalek, 113.50 µs | 1.86× | 0.0%, 0.0% |
